CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Issuarr** is a self-hosted comic book manager and the successor to Mylar3. It finds, downloads, renames, tags and organizes your comics (cbz and cbr) from Usenet, torrents and GetComics, using ComicVine for metadata.
The image is a drop-in replacement for linuxserver/mylar3: point Appdata at your old mylar3 folder and your settings and database carry over.
Install guide: https://issuarr.github.io/issuarr/UNRAID/ Help and bug reports: https://github.com/issuarr/issuarr/issues
